    def setup(self):
        f = Fixture()
        creation = f.gates.register_generated_creation(P, f.creation)
        kernel = Kernel(f)
        manager = DurableSnapshotLifecycle(kernel, f.service, lambda *args: (P, S, G, creation))
        return f, kernel, manager

    def test_reservation_creation_binding_resume_and_clear_order(self):
        f, kernel, manager = self.setup()
        with manager.read_lease("generated", "choice", "revision") as lease:
            session = DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory(manager).open_owned_session(object(), lease.begin_native_session())
            self.assertEqual(f.events[:7], ["open", "sync", "sync", "acquire", "create", "observe", "sync"])
            self.assertEqual(f.events[7], "resume")
            self.assertTrue(session.close_and_join())
            lease.confirm_native_closed()
        self.assertLess(f.events.index("quiet"), f.events.index("release_guards"))
        self.assertLess(f.events.index("release_guards"), f.events.index("confirm_finish"))
        self.assertNotIn(P, f.gates._held)
        self.assertEqual(decode_journal(f.stream.getvalue())[0][-1]["phase"], "CLEARED")

    def test_binding_failure_stops_exact_worker_before_lease_exit(self):
        f, kernel, manager = self.setup()
        with self.assertRaises(PersistenceUnconfirmed):
            with manager.read_lease("generated", "choice", "revision") as lease:
                f.sync_action = lambda: False
                DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory(manager).open_owned_session(object(), lease.begin_native_session())
        self.assertIn("stop_exact", f.events)
        self.assertNotIn("resume", f.events)
        self.assertNotIn("release_guards", f.events)
        self.assertIn(P, f.gates._held)
